start.dialog: Dominion sent a special squad up the Tower after you—elite soldiers, trained for Tower conditions. They're on Floor 52, establishing a forward base. If they get entrenched, they'll harass your climb all the way to the top. Deal with them now, or fight them later when you're exhausted.
start.objective: Locate the Dominion forward base on Floor 52

progress.dialog: Base located, defenses assessed. They've got heavy weapons, barricades, even a construct they've somehow repurposed. Direct assault is costly. Better to sabotage their supplies first, draw them out, then hit them when they're scattered. Classic divide and conquer.
progress.objective: Sabotage Dominion supplies and defeat the scattered squad

complete.dialog: Base destroyed, squad broken, pursuit ended. The Dominion won't stop sending hunters, but you've bought time and sent a message. The Tower doesn't belong to them. Every step you take upward is a step they can't follow. Keep climbing. Leave them in your dust.

party_comments.kade: They just don't learn. The Tower isn't theirs to control. Every time they try, we knock them back down.
party_comments.korr: Those were good soldiers, following bad orders. I recognize the unit insignia—I trained some of them. War makes enemies of us all.
party_comments.vex: Defending the innocent from pursuers. This is the essence of the oath. They shall not pass.
